        raise ValueError("counts contains all-zero cell rows")

    n_cells, n_features = counts.shape

    row_norms = np.linalg.norm(counts, axis=1)
    # column-sum of normalized rows
    col_sum_normalized = np.sum(counts / row_norms[:, np.newaxis], axis=0)
    # diagonal D = row sums of cosine similarity
    D = (counts @ col_sum_normalized) / row_norms
    # guard against possible round-off zeros
    D = np.maximum(D, 1e-12)
    sqrtD = np.sqrt(D)

    # linear operator for M = D^{-1/2} S D^{-1/2}
    def matvec(v):
        # v is length n_cells
        x = v / sqrtD
        temp = counts.T @ (x / row_norms)
        y = (counts @ temp) / row_norms
        return y / sqrtD

    import scipy.sparse.linalg as spla
    M = spla.LinearOperator((n_cells, n_cells), matvec=matvec, dtype=float)

    # compute leading eigenvalues/vectors
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = spla.eigsh(M, k=n_components, which='LM', v0=None)
    # eigsh returns eigenvalues in ascending order; reverse to descending
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues[::-1]
    eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, ::-1]

    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors"}
